allow_large: Owner-approved 2026-09-29 for legacy clean-ups: removes field-specific rejections for job fields that no longer exist; those fields now get the generic unknown-field rejection; no new API surface
done_when: The jobs API, IPC task parsing and scheduler MCP tools no longer mention groupScope, group_scope, requiredTools, required_tools or GANTRY_GROUP_FOLDER; the tool schema no longer advertises required_tools; tests updated

findings.body: The new test checks schema discovery through an in-memory MCP server, but never exercises the running jobs API, IPC processing, or MCP startup with GANTRY_GROUP_FOLDER present. Restoring the deleted field-specific API/IPC errors or environment-variable guards would leave it passing. Existing HTTP coverage at apps/core/test/unit/control/job-trigger.test.ts:1057 checks the unrelated `model` field; the changed scheduler tests call captured schemas/handlers directly. Add suite-wired tests through the real application entry points that fail when these removed behaviors return, using the real database where applicable. The explicit end-to-end test requirement remains unmet despite the valid schema-discovery assertion.
findings.title: Not done: End-to-end regression tests for removed job and scheduler fields

why: Specific 'no longer accepted' errors for removed job and scheduler fields keep old field names alive, and required_tools is still shown to the model as a deprecated tool parameter
